chronology: At observed time t, score saved forecasts with target t, then release only matured labels, update, and issue immutable predictions for t+h. Calibration selection uses target times before eval_start.
evidence_status: Focused development study; no confirmation or population-transfer claim.
model_input_restriction: Only values and declared history/offset metadata enter models. analysis_regimes and analysis_innovations are audit-only.

metadata.boundary_convention: Half-open initial fit [0,fit_end); calibration forecast origins [fit_end,eval_start); evaluation origins [eval_start,n).
metadata.contractivity_note: The deterministic recurrence has sum of absolute lag derivatives at most 0.925 in A and 0.55 in B. This is a stability check, not a predictive advantage claim.
metadata.evidence_status: Fresh synthetic development repetitions from a newly specified simple law; not independent real-source confirmation.
metadata.loss_scale_scope: Initial fitting observations [0,fit_end), before calibration and evaluation.
metadata.missingness_rule: No imputation. Forecast only from finite history; score each horizon only when its individual target is finite. Availability and method failures remain distinct.
metadata.noise_distribution: Independent standard normal innovations from NumPy PCG64, multiplied by 0.20.
metadata.observable_regime_qualification: Regime changes alter the observable conditional mean and dynamics. Their identity is not perfectly observable under noise; no regime labels or transition warnings enter forecasting.
metadata.scale_rule: Mean squared seasonal differences; if unavailable/nonpositive/nonfinite use mean squared first differences; if still invalid use 1.0. No square root.
